# CALMO KIT (calmokit.eu)
> Curated emergency, survival, blackout, and 25-year food preparedness kits — plus individual vetted preparedness gear. Available in English & Spanish. Ships worldwide.

## Flagship Curated Kits
- **72H Crisis Pack (€149)** — 32-piece IPX6 waterproof evacuation backpack with 6 freeze-dried meal pouches, 0.1-micron water filter, solar crank AM/FM radio, 65-piece trauma pod, and thermal bivvy shelters.
- **Wilderness Field Kit (€119)** — 24-piece backcountry and vehicle survival pack (2.9 kg) with thermal shelter roll, ferrocerium fire rod, 750ml titanium cup, stove, and 12-in-1 multitool.
- **Home Blackout & Power Kit (€249)** — 300Wh LiFePO4 indoor-safe power station, 60W foldable IP65 solar panel, 2 magnetic 800-lumen lanterns, and AM/FM emergency radio.
- **Food & Hydration Case (€129)** — 18 servings of 25-year nitrogen-sealed freeze-dried meals (6,800 kcal), 1L insulated stainless canteen, 5,000L water filter, and 50 purification tablets inside an IP67 hard case.

- **Signal EVA Waterproof Trauma Kit (€39.90)** — 85-piece crush-resistant molded medical pod.
- **Solar Crank Emergency Radio (€39.90)** — AM/FM, solar + hand crank, 4000mAh USB-C power bank.
